title: Great first box but...
text:
I've tried almost all of the tea subscriptions out there currently and although this was actually a pretty decent first box (would make a great gift), ultimately this sub is far too expensive for what you receive (in terms of the tea).
This box came with 5 teas in bags, 1 tea in a tin, plus an extra (1 tea bag) "sample" tea. As well as a card describing the teas (the ones that arrived bagged), a recipe for a Mock Mint Green Tea Julep, a bookmark, a small(ish) notepad, and a sachet dish. I believe (although I could be wrong), the sachet dish that came in this box is an extra item that comes only in the first box.
The 5 teas in bags, contained only 2 tea bags each for a total, including the sample, of 11 tea bags and a small tin of tea. The first cup with a tea bag took quite awhile (longer than the recommended 3-5 minutes) to get a even a fair amount of color and flavor of tea, into the water. I tried re-using the tea bags, as stated in the description (2-3 cups per bag) with very little success. The second (I wouldn't even dare try a third) cup of tea, I let each bag steep overnight, and never did get even close to the first cups' amount of tea into the water. In other words....I was only able to get one satisfactory cup of tea out of each tea bag. Now as I previously stated, I have tried just about every tea subscription out there and I ALWAYS reuse my teas to make two, three and sometimes even four cups each time but I was not able to get even close to that, out of these teas. Granted, I have only tried three of the teas in one monthly box but, in terms of the tea alone, I certainly didn't feel like I had gotten my moneys worth.
This sub seems to be about more than just the tea itself though and if you are in it for the extra(s) as much as the tea itself, you may find it to be worth your money. Though it just wasn't for me.
Thank you for your time. Hope you are well.
label: neutral
